simple.summary: יַעֲזִיָּהוּ (Yaʻăzîyâhûw) means Jaazijah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 24 26.

definitions.full: H3269. Yaaziyyahu יַעֲזִיָּ֫הוּ proper name, masculine Οζεια ( ς ), Levite name 1Chr 24:26-27 , perhaps for עֻזִּיָּהוּ Gray Prop. N. 291 .
